name: SunState Solar Inc
old_description: Help protect the environment, and your wallet, by powering your home with 100% renewable energy
about:
SunState Solar Inc operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a locally owned solar installation company serving the Albuquerque, Santa Fe, and surrounding areas. The business was established to provide customized solar panel installations and cutting-edge technology for residential and commercial customers, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Key personnel include Glenn Felty, who leads the team, and Ian, who serves as service manager.

The company designs, installs, and services photovoltaic systems, including battery storage and roof-integrated arrays. Its scope covers consultation, system design optimized for energy production, professional installation, permitting with utilities such as PNM and the New Mexico Energy Department, and assistance with state and federal tax incentives. SunState Solar also adopts orphaned systems, handling reconnection and upgrades for homeowners whose original installers are no longer available. The firm coordinates roof replacement when needed and provides a lifetime warranty on its work.

Customers are primarily homeowners and businesses in central and northern New Mexico seeking renewable energy solutions. The company works with equipment from manufacturers such as SolarEdge for inverters and batteries, and its projects have included whole-house backup systems up to 8.1 kW of panels with 20 kWh of storage.

SunState Solar emphasizes its local expertise and personalized approach, offering tailored consultations, efficient installations, and ongoing support. Its lifetime assurance warranty and willingness to service systems installed by others differentiate it in the New Mexico market.
